dimensions.assessment: Affects Medicare Advantage organizations and millions of Medicare beneficiaries reviewing plan choices and financial transparency data.
dimensions.evidence: This bill requires Medicare Advantage (MA) organizations to publish certain information regarding revenue and expenses and to present information about benefits in a certain manner.

dimensions.assessment: Imposes new transparency, reporting, and electronic formatting requirements on health plans without altering underlying benefit structures directly.
dimensions.evidence: a contract under this section with an MA organization shall require the organization, with respect to each MA plan offered... to submit to the Secretary and publish on the public website

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal appropriations or spending increases are stated; administrative costs for compliance are not quantified.
Amends the Social Security Act to add reporting mandates and standardize electronic benefit disclosures for Medicare Advantage plans.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title XVIII of the Social Security Act to promote transparency of Medicare Advantage plan information.

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently beginning with plan years on or after January 1, 2029.
dimensions.evidence: Beginning with plan years beginning on or after January 1, 2029

missing_information: Administrative cost estimates for compliance by Medicare Advantage organizations
importance_detail.rationale: This bill requires Medicare Advantage organizations to publish detailed revenue, claims, and non-claims overhead cost information and standardizes electronic benefit formats for beneficiaries.
